newestFirst.content: Audit complete: 34 subsystems, 67 verified findings, report in docs/audit.md. Three product/engineering calls are yours: whether to delete the abandoned prompt-optimization pipeline and its five tables (nothing reads it), whether geo constraints should be enforced or stop being collected, and whether the worker-invite signup flow should be opened. The report ends with a ranked plan and four first slices.
